Class DbArray

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.models.DbAbstractCollection
dev.visdb.seesaw.models.DbArray
All Implemented Interfaces:
DbCollection
public class DbArray extends DbAbstractCollection
Implementation of SsCollectionModel as an array that uses a database JDBCType.ARRAY for storage. The order of items is preserved by readData and writeData.
Since:
4.0.0
